name: Git repositories
description: The state of all your git repositories at a glance: fetch, pull, push and commit without a terminal.

badges.aheadTitle: {n} commit(s) to push. Click to see the history.

branchTitle.tracking: Branch {branch}, tracks {upstream}. Click to see the branches.
branchTitle.untracked: Branch {branch}, no tracked branch. Click to see the branches.
branchTitle.detached: Detached HEAD: no branch is checked out. Click to see the branches.

badges.conflictTitle: Some files are in conflict: resolve them with git before committing.
badges.operationTitle: A {op} is in progress in this repository: finish or abort it with git.
badges.detachedTitle: No branch is checked out: pull, push and commit are disabled.
badges.noRemoteTitle: This repository has no remote: nothing to fetch or push.
badges.unpublishedTitle: This branch does not exist on the remote yet: “Push” will publish it.
badges.upToDateTitle: Nothing to commit, push or pull.
badges.errorTitle: The last operation failed. git said: {message}

commit.title: Commit {name}
commit.summary: No file will be committed | 1 file will be committed | {n} files will be committed

folders.title: Root folders
folders.hint: The git repositories under these folders are discovered automatically.

empty.noRoots: Choose one or more folders that contain your git repositories.
empty.noGit: git was not found on this computer. Install it, for example with the following command, then restart Wrench:
empty.noRepos: No git repository was found in your folders.

errors.not_a_repo: This folder is no longer a git repository.
errors.diverged: The local and remote branches have diverged: neither a fast-forward pull nor a push is possible.
errors.detached_head: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch first.
errors.in_progress: A git operation (merge, rebase…) is in progress, or conflicts are unresolved, in this repository.
errors.auth_required: Authentication required: sign in to the remote with git once.
errors.timeout: The git operation took too long.
errors.git_not_found: git was not found on this computer.
errors.busy: An operation is already running on this repository.
errors.unknown_ref: This branch no longer exists: refresh the list.
